title: Stage 4 v3-LV: identity-removed occurrence ICA on raw-residual PCs 65-256 at L12 (structure beyond the top-64 variance directions)
layers: L12 only, at the output of decoder layer 12 (the e60/e65 hook). Reasons: it is the only layer where the e65 rig validates (the quote anchor passed B3, B4 and C), and the only layer with raw rows for a feasibility read (results/e67_raw_L12_rows.npy). L7 is excluded because the e65 paren anchor failed twice and there are no raw L7 rows. L24 is excluded because the probe ceiling is below every floor. PCs 257-512 are deferred to a later prereg on the spare range: there the SAE error is 56% of the variance, but the controls are weaker (paren block probe 0.718).
representation: INPUT. The RAW L12 residual h, not the SAE-decoded one. gemma-3-1b-pt runs in bf16, as in e60/e65. A new extractor, scripts/e68_extract_raw.py, is e60 with the SAE encode/decode removed. Coordinate 1038 (e61.drop_for(12)) is zeroed before the cast to fp16, and the script asserts finite values with max|x| < 60,000 on the kept coordinates. bf16 values are exact in fp16: on D2 the kept coordinates have median |h| 16.4, p99 107 and max 2,048. ROWS. Positions >= 4; token types with >= 8 rows in the set (the v2 rule). FIRST MOMENT. Type, document and position means are subtracted in turn, and the cycle runs 3 times (e63.represent_base, unchanged). PCA. Full eigendecomposition of the float64 covariance (1,151 x 1,151) of every third row, fitted on each set's own rows. P3 gets its own fit for calibration and D3 its own fit for discovery. R3 and S3 have their own first moments removed, are then mapped with D3's frozen PCA and whitening maps, and are never refitted: near-degenerate low eigenvalues would carve a refitted block differently. SEARCH BLOCK A. Components 65-256 (192 dims), each scaled to unit variance; the boundaries are fixed now. D2 feasibility (raw, first-moment removed): the top-64 PCs hold only 38.3% of the variance and PCs 65-256 hold 28.4%. The spectrum is flat (lambda65 = 1,773, lambda256 = 716). The bf16 rounding variance is <= 1.1e-5 of every eigenvalue at every rank, so precision never binds. The L12 16k l0_big SAE error carries 11.6% of the variance in PCs 1-64, 29.9% in 65-256 and 55.8% in 257-1151. SECOND MOMENT. Calibrated on P3 among exactly three settings: none; per-type whitening inside the 192-d block with (N_MIN 256, n0 128); and with (N_MIN 512, n0 256). Each is followed by a global re-whitening. The choice follows v2's Step-A rule: the lowest median self-excluded TDI of k-means K = 128, subject to a paren block-probe >= none - 0.02; ties go to none. v2's N_MIN 32 is excluded because a 32-row S_t is rank-32 in 192 dims, so shrinkage would inject type-specific scaling. Without the step, D2 gives KIR 19.2 and a max eta2(token) of y^2 over the 192 ICA units of 0.26. Types with >= 256 rows hold 58% of the rows. UNITS. Full-rank FastICA-192 with the logcosh and skewness (G(u) = u^3/3) contrasts, whiten='unit-variance', fitted on every second row, max_iter 1,000, tol 1e-4. Seeds: 0 for the main fit, 1 and 2 for the even- and odd-sequence halves, with retries at s+100 and s+200 (v2's failure rules). On D2 the logcosh fit converged in 179 iterations (12 s). REFERENCE FOR THE SHADOW SCREEN. Components 1-64 of the same PCA, with the same second-moment rule, ICA-64 logcosh and skew. DIRECTIONS. Steering uses the pattern pullback d_u = sign_u * normalise(U_A diag(sd_A) Cov(Z_A, y_u)), embedded with 1038 = 0 (e64 section 8.2 with the block basis).
positive_control: LABELS. paren_inside (used for tuning on P3) and quote_inside (never used in any choice), with the v1 e61 battery definitions. PRESENCE IN BLOCK A, measured on D2 L12 raw (a disclosed read-only feasibility look). Held-out logistic probe (train on even sequences, test on odd), PCs 65-256 alone: paren 0.780 (PCs 1-64 alone 0.784; PCs 1-256 0.818); quote 0.740 (PCs 1-64 0.776). Share of the whitened class-mean-difference d'^2 (top 512 PCs) that lies in 65-256: paren 46%, quote 35%. One ICA-192 logcosh fit without the per-type step: paren is carried by one unit, #146, at |AUROC| 0.720. Its heavy-tail 1% is 58.6% paren against a 3.1% base; split-half |cos| 0.93; eta2(y^2) 0.07. Quote is carried by #128 at 0.659 (68.7% against 6.0%; split-half 0.90). STATISTIC. The max |AUROC| over screened units, per contrast. FLOOR = clip(0.5 + 0.6*(probe_P3,blockA - 0.5), 0.65, 0.85). NULL. Token-matched label permutation (v2 null_engine): 1,000 permutations; the gate is the p99.9 of the max-over-screened-units statistic. LOOKS. 2 labels x 2 contrasts = 4 at p99.9, so the family-wise false recovery is <= 0.4%. PASS iff either label is recovered: at or above the floor and above the null p99.9. Reported but not gating: the tail-enrichment statistic against the same null, the held-out D3 probe, and the unscreened maxima. SHADOW-SCREEN SELF-TEST. Every recovered control unit must be flagged TOP64-SHADOW; on D2 their tails are ranked by one top-64 unit at |AUROC| 0.77 (paren) and 0.85 (quote). DISCLOSURE: CONSTANTS SET WITH D2 IN VIEW. Several constants were chosen after D2's unit/probe ratios (paren 0.72/0.78, quote 0.66/0.74) and the controls' readability (0.77, 0.85) were seen: the 0.6 multiplier and the 0.65 lower clip (v2 used 0.75 and 0.70); the 0.75 shadow threshold; the block boundary 256; and the tail-diversity thresholds. On D2 the formula would give floors of 0.668 (paren) and 0.644 (quote). Quote's floor is therefore effectively the 0.65 clip, and D2's quote unit (0.659) clears it by only 0.009. P3 is the first data the frozen formula meets blind. HONEST LIMIT. Both controls are the low-variance part of variables that also live in the top 64. On D2 no single unit isolated a known variable native to the block. after_colon has a block probe of 0.911 with 82% of its d'^2 beyond PC 64, but its best single unit reaches only 0.641 with an unenriched tail; in_caps_run reaches 0.584, bracket_inside 0.617 and code_markup 0.560. PLANTED-SOURCE POWER CURVE (on P3; reported, not gating). A synthetic state variable is added along a random block direction (seed 7100): runs of 5-20 consecutive tokens with a 0.5% base rate, at delta in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3} whitened SDs. The smallest delta at which one ICA-192 unit matches it (|cos| >= 0.8, |AUROC| >= 0.9) is the detection limit quoted with any null result.
control_fallback: P3 LADDER, fixed order. The first rung at which paren or quote is recovered at the P3-derived floor and null is frozen; quote is never used to choose. (1) The Step-A second-moment choice. (2) The other two second-moment settings, in the listed order. (3) A narrower block, PCs 65-192 (128-d), with the Step-A choice. IF NO RUNG RECOVERS A CONTROL ON P3: STOP before any D3 extraction. The verdict is 'block A is not searchable by this instrument at L12', reported with the P3 probe ceilings and the planted-source detection limit. OPTIONAL CONTINUATION, only on the user's explicit go-ahead: proceed on a planted-source instrument control alone. Its pass rule: delta = 1.5 is recovered at |cos| >= 0.8 on D3 for 3 of 3 planted seeds (7100, 7101, 7102). Without a natural control there is no block anchor, so the behavioural tier cannot issue a verdict and every outcome is capped at 'exploratory geometric lead'. IF D3'S CONTROL FAILS AFTER P3 PASSED: STOP ('instrument not validated on D3'). No unit is labelled, and S3, R3 and D3's behaviour reserves stay unused. IF THE CONTROLS PASS BUT NO BEHAVIOURAL VERDICT IS POSSIBLE (no recovered control has a blind signature with >= 5 tokens, or the block anchor fails on B5): the geometric, replication and coverage tiers are still reported, and the claim is capped at 'replicated, uncovered geometric lead'. That is not a discovery. IF THE SHADOW SCREEN FAILS ITS SELF-TEST (a recovered control unit is not flagged): the pre-registered fallback threshold (tail readability >= 0.70) is used, and the failure is reported.
data_splits: SOURCE. results/corpus_tokens_pass1.i32 (15,696 x 255, BOS dropped; e60 prepends BOS). Only ranges never used for occurrence-level Stage-4 work are used. Each set extracts L12 only, with e68 (raw). P3 (calibration): corpus 2,000-2,999, 1,000 seqs, about 203k kept rows. D3 (discovery: units, screens, control, labels): 3,000-4,999, 2,000 seqs, about 406k rows. That is twice D2, so each split half is the size of all of D2, to support 192-d ICA. S3 (context-shuffled null): D3's own 2,000 sequences, shuffled within each sequence with e60's --shuffle rule (seed 600,000 + sequence index). R3 (replication): 5,000-6,999, 2,000 seqs, mapped with D3's maps. B5 (steering test sites): 7,000-7,999. B6 (held-out steering): 8,000-8,999. C3 (confirmation): 9,000-9,999, sealed; it is touched only by the confirm phase, after the B5 and B6 outputs are hashed. UNTOUCHED SPARES: 10,000-12,999 (reserved for the PCs 257-512 follow-up or a crash re-run) and 15,000-15,695 (only 696 seqs, too small for a set). STEERING SITES (rig rule). 200 distinct sequences per block; one position each, uniform in [4, 254] of the 255-token row; the prompt is BOS + T[s, max(0, p-64) : p+1]. Site/RAND seeds: 6800/6810 + L (B5), 6900/6910 + L (B6), 7000/7010 + L (C3). OVERLAP DISCLOSURE (e65 section 0.5 style). These corpus ranges were averaged into the Stage-1 type means (typemeans_pass1) and nothing else. No v3 object uses those means, because identity removal uses each set's own rows. SEEN BEFORE FREEZING (to go into the prereg's section 0). D2 L12 raw rows (corpus 1,000-1,999, disjoint from every v3 set), read-only from results/e67_raw_L12_rows.npy, results/occ_units_v2_L12.npz, cache/occ/occD2_meta.npz and results/e64c_d2_pieces.json; the SAE weights were read from hf_home. What was computed: the spectrum; block probes for 8 battery labels; d'^2 shares; one ICA-192 logcosh fit plus one half fit; v1-battery naming of the 192 units; tail readability by top-64 units; tail diversity; and SAE-error shares. The constants fixed after this look are listed under positive_control. HASH CHAIN (v2's pattern). This design (as the calibration plan), e68_extract_raw.py and the analysis script are hashed in docs/HASHES.txt before P3 is extracted. The feasibility record (the scratch lv_feas*_L12.json files and feas_summary.txt) is copied into docs/ and hashed at the same time. The P3 choice file is hashed and its sha written into the frozen PREREG_occurrence_v3_lowvar.md, which is hashed before D3 is extracted. Each later phase's outputs are hashed before the next phase starts.
units_and_screens: UNITS. ICA-192 logcosh and ICA-192 skew on D3 block A: 384 directions. Logcosh/skew pairs with |cos| >= 0.8 are twins and are counted as one family (e64 section 5). SCREENS (frozen before any label). (a) eta2(token) of y <= 0.30. (b) eta2(token) of y^2 <= 0.30. (c) Split-half |cos|, the smaller of the even and odd halves in the same D3 basis, >= 0.80. The floor comes from the grid {0.80, 0.70} on P3: 0.80 unless the recovering P3 control unit falls below it. Chance is the p99.9 of the best match for 10,000 random directions in 192 dims, reported (about 0.35 expected). (d) Tail diversity (new), on the heavy-tail 1% (about 4,060 rows on D3): >= 200 documents, >= 50 token types, largest type share <= 0.30, and largest single-document share <= 0.02. On D2 (2,034 tail rows; the D2-equivalent document cap is 0.04), 181/192 units pass, all 11 failures on type share. The controls pass with margin: #146 has 654 documents, 788 types, type share 0.059 and document share 0.012; #128 has 384, 596, 0.059 and 0.019. Bimodality is off. OTHER D2 FEASIBILITY NUMBERS (one half only). Split-half median 0.73; 82/192 units >= 0.8; control units 0.88-0.93. eta2(y^2) max 0.26. Median excess kurtosis 3.1, with 172/192 units > 1. NAMING (label phase, mechanical, in order). (1) The e64 extended battery under the section 6.1 rule: |AUROC| >= 0.75, or a 1% tail >= 3x the base rate and >= 0.10; graded features |rho| >= 0.5. On D2 the v1 battery alone names 64/192 block units, mostly through after_digit (29), next_continuation (13) and next_newline (12). (2) The 16 e64c rules, scored on an en_core_web_trf parse of D3, at |AUROC| >= 0.65. (3) Next-token category rules (the e66 categories: preposition, subordinator, temporal, punctuation, newline, digit, capitalised) at |AUROC| >= 0.65. These name the confirmed-but-covered L12 adjunct family and its relatives. (4) TOP64-SHADOW: u's heavy-tail-1% indicator is ranked at |AUROC| >= 0.75 by some single D3 top-64 reference unit, or u's heavy tail overlaps that unit's two-sided 2% tail at >= 0.25. On D2, 22/192 units reach 0.75. (5) V2-SHADOW: |cos| >= 0.5 between u's raw-space pattern and any of the 78 screened frozen e64 L12 directions (e64_maps_L12.npz). (6) Analyst context reading, only for units that survive 1-5, under the e64 section 6.2 standard (>= 8 of 12 contexts share one specific construction). It is sealed before S3. CANDIDATES = screened and unnamed by 1-6. On D2, 97/192 logcosh units are battery-unnamed with readability < 0.70, and about 43% pass the repro screen. Expect about 30-60 candidates across both contrasts before S3/R3/coverage. REPORTED FOR EVERY UNIT. Tail-TDI and the identity-suspect flag. SAE-error share of the score: the variance of the score computed from h - SAE(h) (L12 16k big), divided by the score's variance; on D2 block units sit at 0.29-0.35 and top-64 units at 0.12-0.19. Energy in the boundary bands (components 65-80 and 241-256). Seed stability (a seed-3 refit). Max |cos| to the e64 L12 directions.
nulls_and_gates: G1. CONTROL on D3, as in positive_control. Token-matched permutation null, p99.9, 4 looks. G2. S3 PRESENCE. S3 uses its own first moments and D3's maps, with an independent ICA refit (both contrasts). A D3 unit matched by an S3 unit at |cos| >= 0.8 is context-generic and barred from the top class. G3. S3 YIELD, a stage gate defined like for like. On D3 and on S3 alike: units that are screened, unnamed by naming step 1 (battery), and not TOP64-SHADOW (step 4), where S3's shadow test uses S3's own ICA-64 top-64 reference in D3 coordinates. Naming steps 2-3 (parse and next-token rules) and step 6 (reading) enter D3's pipeline but not this gate, because parse rules are meaningless on shuffled text. The gate passes iff the D3 count >= 1.25 x the S3 count and D3 - S3 >= 5. Otherwise STOP before R3 and behaviour: 'no in-context excess beyond the top-64 at L12'. (Reference: v2 at L12 had 51 against 27.) G4. R3 REPLICATION. R3 uses its own first moments and D3's maps, with an independent ICA refit. A D3 unit u replicates iff its best R3 match has |cos| >= 0.8, that match passes every screen on R3 (including the R3 split-half and tail diversity), and it is still unnamed by steps 1, 3 and 4 on R3. A replication anchor: a control unit must replicate (|cos| >= 0.8, |AUROC| >= its D3 floor on R3), or the replication tier is uninformative and no discovery is claimed. Reported: the chance p99.9 of |cos|, KIR on R3, and the principal-angle overlap between D3's block and R3's own block. G5. COVERAGE BEFORE STEERING, as in coverage_check. COVERED units are not steered. G6. BEHAVIOUR ON B5, as in behavioural_tier. G7. B6 held-out. G8. C3 confirmation. TOP CLASS ('confirmed, uncovered, unnamed beyond-top-64 occurrence variable') requires: the screens; unnamed by 1-6; not context-generic; R3-replicated; NOT COVERED; PASS on B5 and on B6; and CONFIRMED on C3. A PARTIALLY COVERED survivor is reported as 'confirmed, partially covered'. EXPECTED FALSE PASSES. Per unit and block, max(1/100, 1/(n'+1)) = 0.010. With n' about 100-150 screened block units, the RAND bound binds. The layer excess rule (e65): B5 passes count only if their number among candidates exceeds the sum of the per-unit bounds.
behavioural_tier: The e65 rig is reused unchanged except for the subspace of the RAND bank and the site source. Model in bf16, eager attention, MPS; the push is applied at the site position only. DOSE. c*sigma_d with c in {0.5, 1, 2, 4}, gate at c* = 2; sign consistency (the share of the 20 commonest site token types with mean Delta > 0) >= 0.8 at some c <= 2. sigma_d is the raw SD of the unsteered projection at prompt positions >= 4. bf16 is adequate for block directions: block-A SDs are about 27-42 even after identity removal, so a 2-sigma push is about 0.06*sigma_d per coordinate, well above bf16's half-ulp at the kept coordinates (median |h| 16, p99 107). e66 measured a realised dose of 0.999-1.000 at L12. A unit whose realised dose at c* is < 0.9 is 'dose-void' and gets no verdict. READOUT. Delta = [lse(logits[T_u]) - lse(logits[R_u])] steered minus unsteered. T_u is the blind signature from the next tokens of D3's heavy-tail 1% (e64.signature); R_u is frequency-matched (+-10% corpus count, seed 6400 + L order as e65). TWO RAND BANKS ON B5. (i) For the rig anchor: 99 directions pulled back from e64's 64-d L12 subspace (P_U, P_sd from e64_maps_L12.npz), as in e65, with fresh seed 6810 + L. (ii) For block units: 99 directions g ~ N(0, I_192) in D3 block-A whitened coordinates, pulled back with U_A diag(sd_A) g, embedded with 1038 = 0, normalised, each dosed by its own sigma. Both banks are not orthogonalised; the max |cos| to each unit is reported. SIG. u's push is scored with every other screened block-A unit's signature (twin excluded, T_u tokens removed, v used only if >= 5 tokens remain). PASS = Delta_uu(c*) > 0, sign consistency, Delta > the RAND max, and Delta > the SIG max. ORDER ON B5. (1) Rig-continuity anchor: the frozen e64 L12 logcosh #33 (quote) with its e64 signature, against bank (i). If it fails, STOP behaviour: the rig or the site source is broken. (2) Block anchor: D3's recovered quote unit, or the paren unit if quote was not recovered (paren failed at L12 in e65; quote passed three times), against bank (ii). If it fails: 'no behavioural verdict in block A'. (3) Supervised block anchor, NON-GATING: the P3 quote probe direction restricted to block A and pulled back, at all four doses. It separates 'block directions carry no causal weight' from 'the ICA control unit is too weak'. (4) Only if (1) and (2) pass: every candidate surviving G2-G5, at all four doses. B6. The block anchor and every B5 pass, on fresh sites, with fresh sigma and a fresh block-A bank (seed 6910 + L). If the B6 anchor fails, no B6 verdict is issued. C3 (pre-registered now, e66 style). One primary test per surviving family, the logcosh member first; the block anchor goes first; CONFIRMED iff the primary passes the same rule. Per-test bound 0.010; expected false confirmations <= 0.01 x the number of families. Named non-candidate units are not steered: the sibling rank is dropped to save time.
coverage_check: This is e67's rubric adapted to block directions. It runs on every R3-replicated candidate BEFORE steering (G5), and again in full (including Neuronpedia lookups for the L13 resid_post dictionaries) on any C3-confirmed family. DICTIONARIES (already on disk): resid_post_all 16k l0_big and l0_small at L10, L11, L12, L13 and L14; resid_post L13 65k l0_big, 16k l0_medium and 65k l0_medium. The 262k dictionaries are used only if the user approves a re-download and the folder stays under 18 GB after the activation caches are deleted. COVERED iff a single latent has decoder |cos| >= 0.7 with d_u AND above the block-subspace null p99.9 (1,000 random block-A pullbacks; the isotropic null is reported too), OR activation |r| >= 0.7 with u's D3 score; AND that latent passes a behavioural match. Behavioural match: among the latent's 200 strongest D3 rows, the next-token-in-T_u rate is >= 0.8x the unit's own heavy-tail rate and >= 2x the base rate; or >= 25% of those rows lie in u's heavy 1% tail. PARTIALLY COVERED iff <= 5 signed-OMP decoder rows reach cos 0.9; NOT COVERED otherwise. Also reported: atoms needed for cos 0.8 and 0.9 (signed and non-negative OMP) against the null median; the best activation |r|; and the SAE-error share of the unit's score for every dictionary at L12 and L13. A unit with error share >= 0.5 is labelled 'SAE-dark'; on D2 no block unit got there (max 0.35). Activations are computed from D3's stored raw rows with the dictionaries' own fp32 JumpReLU encode, in float32 throughout (the e67b lesson).
falsifiers_and_stop_rules: F0. P3: no control recovered on any rung of the ladder -> STOP before D3. 'Block A is not searchable at L12'; the probe ceilings and the planted detection limit are reported. F1. D3: no control recovered -> STOP before labels. F2. Shadow self-test fails -> switch to the 0.70 readability fallback and report it (not a stop). F3. S3 yield gate fails -> STOP before R3 and behaviour: 'the unnamed ICA structure beyond PC 64 is mostly what ICA also finds in word salad'. F4. No control replicates on R3 -> the replication tier is uninformative and no discovery is claimed. F5. All replicated candidates are COVERED -> 'beyond-top-64 structure exists but Gemma Scope 2 already has it' (the goal's negative answer); no behaviour is run. F6. The rig-continuity anchor fails on B5 -> STOP behaviour (rig or site source broken). F7. The block anchor fails on B5 -> 'no behavioural verdict in block A'; the outcome is capped at 'replicated, uncovered geometric lead'. The supervised anchor's result says whether block directions lack causal weight or only the ICA unit is weak. F8. B5 candidate passes <= the sum of the per-unit bounds -> none counted. F9. No B5 pass survives B6, or no family is confirmed on C3 -> verdict: 'no uncovered, unnamed occurrence variable in raw L12 PCs 65-256 found by this instrument'. This is quoted with the planted detection limit and is not a claim that none exists. GLOBAL FALSIFIER of the angle's premise: either F3 or F5 alone answers 'is there SAE-missed in-context structure beyond the top 64?' with no or largely no. RESOURCE STOPS (e64 D1 guard): swap > 16 GB at any stage start; folder > 18 GB (delete caches first, then stop); system free disk < 8 GB -> abort. A partial output is deleted and re-run once (e65 section 13), and the re-run is reported. Every phase needs the user's go-ahead.
compute_disk_estimate: EXTRACTION (MPS). Raw L12 only, with no SAE step: about 1.5-2 min per 1,000 seqs, judging from e60's 103-198 s for 3 layers plus the SAE. P3 + D3 + S3 + R3 = 7,000 seqs, about 12-15 min. DISK. fp16 at L12 is 0.59 GB per 1,000 seqs: P3 0.59 GB; D3, S3 and R3 1.18 GB each. They are processed in sequence: P3 is deleted after the choice freeze, S3 after G2/G3, R3 after G4, and D3 after G5. D3's units are kept as an fp16 npz (406k x 384, about 0.31 GB) together with the maps and meta. Peak folder about 15 GB (now 12 GB; cap 20 GB; the volume has 32 GB free). Final folder about 12.6 GB. RAM. D3's V is about 1.9 GB in float32, plus float64 column-block temporaries; ranks for 384 units about 1.25 GB. CPU. One ICA-192 fit took 12 s on 101k D2 rows, so expect 0.5-1.5 min per fit on D3 (203k rows), with skew slower. That is 6 fits per representation, plus the ICA-64 reference: P3 with 3 settings and the planted curve, about 20-30 min; D3, S3 and R3, about 10 min each. Permutation null: 2 labels x 1,000 permutations, a few minutes. trf parse of D3 (510k tokens): about 20-30 min. COVERAGE. SAE encodes of D3's 406k rows for 13 dictionaries, about 15-20 min on MPS. BEHAVIOUR (about 9.2 s per 200-prompt pass, e65). B5: 1 unsteered + 99 (64-d bank) + 99 (block bank) + 4 rig anchor + 4 block anchor + 4 second control + 4 supervised anchor + 4 x N candidates (N about 10-25 after G2-G5) = 255-315 passes, about 40-50 min. B6: about 110-130 passes, 17-20 min. C3: about 105-115 passes, about 17 min. TOTALS. About 1.7 h MPS and 1.5-2 h CPU, so about 4 h of wall time spread over about 11 user-approved phases: calibrate, freeze, control, label, seal-reading, shuffled, replicate, coverage, steer B5, steer B6, confirm C3.
main_risks: 1. THE BLOCK IS ONLY PARTLY SAE-DARK. On D2, block units' scores are about 31% SAE error (median 0.313, max 0.35, none >= 0.5), against 17% for top-64 units, and block A's variance is 30% error. ICA is not preferentially finding dark structure here. Block A is honestly 'the first block where the SAE starts to fail'; it is not a dark subspace. The coverage gate may well return COVERED or PARTIALLY COVERED for most candidates, as e67 did. PCs 257-512 (56% error) are the named follow-up, on spare range 10,000-12,999. 2. THE CONTROLS ARE SHADOWS. paren and quote are the low-variance part of variables that also live in the top 64. The instrument is validated for 'state variables partly in the block', not for block-native ones; no native known variable was isolated by one unit on D2. The planted detection limit bounds what a null result excludes. 3. THE BLOCK ANCHOR MAY HAVE NO CAUSAL WEIGHT. Pushing the low-variance component of quote state may not beat random block directions. That would leave block A with no behavioural verdict, as L7 was left (paren failed at L12 even in the top 64). This is the single largest term in p_positive. 4. THIN CONTROL MARGINS AND CONSTANTS SET AFTER A LOOK. Quote cleared D2's would-be floor by 0.009. The 0.6 multiplier, the 0.65 clip, K_max 256, the 0.75 shadow threshold and the tail-diversity caps were set with D2 in view (disclosed); P3 is the first blind use. 5. BOUNDARY AND BASIS INSTABILITY. lambda64/lambda65 differ by 1.8%, about 3 sampling SEs at about 68k PCA rows, and lambda256 is about lambda257, so units near the edges can rotate between sets. Mapping R3 and S3 through D3's maps, the boundary-band diagnostic and the R3 principal-angle report mitigate this but do not remove it. Only 43% of D2 units passed repro >= 0.8 on a single half. 6. LOCAL-CONTEXT VARIABLES DOMINATE. On D2 the battery names 64/192 units, mostly after_digit and next_* features; e64c's post hoc rules later named 9 v2 candidates. Survivors may again be previous- or next-token variables, nameable after the fact. 7. IDENTITY LEAKAGE. KIR 19.2 in the block without the per-type step, and per-type whitening in 192 dims is untested at scale. 8. LOAD AND MULTIPLICITY. 384 units; a reading load of perhaps 60-100 units; one analyst throughout (as in e64/e65). 9. THE SITES ARE CORPUS ROWS, NOT A FRESH RESERVE.
